item.title: azure: [In preview] Generally Available: Customize backup retention from 1 to 35 days in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB backup retention can now be configured from 1 to 35 days. This lets deployments match retention settings to application and data protection requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: More ways to request and configure Copilot code reviews
item.description:
GitHub Copilot code review now supports more personal configuration options, is available to a broader set of Copilot plans, and adds an enterprise-level default setting. These changes are generally available.

  • Source: GitHub
